## 2. Materials and Methods2. Materials and Methods
## 2.1. Preparation of the Metal Solution Using Aqua Regia2.1. Preparation of the Metal Solution Using Aqua Regia
First, the camera parts and PCB parts attached to the mobile phone waste were separated and collected for the experiment (Figure 1). The process of separating and recovering metals, including both ferrous and non-ferrous metals, as well as precious metals from the mobile phone waste, is shown in Figure 2. The camera and the PCB parts separated from the mobile phone waste were crushed in a pulverizer for 2 min and were divided into pulverized particles and non-pulverized materials (e.g., copper foil, insulation film, etc.).
